column1: # Database manifest (audit X14; ported from pksProfiler c08098d conf/databases.tsv).
# The reference databases and indexes CMPipeline reads, frozen with a release label and a cheap
# fingerprint. scripts/database_versions.py recomputes the fingerprint at the end of every run for
# the databases that run used (finalize_provenance.py), compares it with this file, and writes the
# verdict (frozen / CHANGED: listing / CHANGED: key / not_in_manifest / unused) to RUN_REPORT.txt
# (DATABASE VERSIONS) and the provenance JSON (`databases`). A rebuilt or substituted database is
# then visible in the run's own record instead of hiding behind an unchanged path. Checked by
# tests/test_database_versions.py. A record, not a gate: a CHANGED database does not stop a run.
# COLUMNS
#   name / param / stage  the record row, the pipeline parameter holding its path, the stage that
#                  reads it (a run that does not request the stage records `unused`).
#                  bracken_kmer_distrib is a view of --kraken_db (Bracken has no database of its own)
#   release        the version label, as documented under `source` (not inferred from a directory name
#                  alone: a directory can be renamed or a new release dropped into the old one)
#   select         which files of the directory the row covers (glob on the relative path; * = all)
#   size_bytes, file_count, newest_mtime   as measured on TSCC on frozen_on
#   fingerprint    sha256:listing = sha256 over sorted "<relative path>\t<size>\n" lines of every regular
#                  file (one line for a single file). Identical to pksProfiler's method: the frozen
#                  values for kraken_db, hg38_db and t2t_phix_db equal pksProfiler's (recomputed here)
#   key_method / key_files / key_sha256    the content check, recomputed every run:
#                  sha256:files = sha256 over sorted "<name>\t<sha256 of content>\n" of the key files;
#                  mmi:dictionary = sha256 of the .mmi header + sequence dictionary (first kB). Empty
#                  for databases with no small release-defining file (ChocoPhlAn, UniRef, pangenome)
#   newest_mtime   compared, but NOT identity: a copy or restore rewrites mtimes; reported as a note
# Not hashed per run: database.kdb (574 GB), the Bowtie2/DIAMOND indexes, the .mmi minimizer buckets.
# The integrity check for those is `sha256sum <file>`, run deliberately (hours of Lustre reads).
# To re-freeze after a deliberate database change (fingerprint columns; edit release/source by hand):
#   python3 scripts/database_versions.py freeze kraken_db=<path> ...
